Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview, and candidates need to appear on the specified date. There is no separate last date for application submission before the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration offered is Rs. 28,000 plus 20% HRA. Increments are admissible as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a three-year Graduate degree (BMLT) with three years of experience, or a PG degree (MSc MLT) / MSc Microbiology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-III post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III position at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents related to age, qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Technical Support-III position is purely temporary.
